method:
Compare linked/unlinked input gain and digital mute with a real mic.

The live microphone/ambient signal is measured simultaneously before and
after routing to unused outputs 5/6. No tone, playback or raw recording.
microphone: BETA 58A input 1, 40 dB temporary gain, 48V off; input 2 has no microphone
limits: RMS meter comparison from live input 1; no calibrated physical gain or second microphone claim
restoration_note: Both complete readable snapshots equal the shared sweep state exactly; the reference avoids duplicating 2252 unchanged messages.
